scope: Initial Character collection: mercy, patience, humility, generosity, justice, forgiveness, honesty, and family/community. A selected Sunni-source corpus, not an exhaustive edition or scholarly certification.
digestDefinition: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify of unique [primarySourceUrl, arabicFull] pairs, sorted by primarySourceUrl.localeCompare(otherUrl, 'en'). A transcription fingerprint, not a scholarly authenticity judgement.
method: Two separately assigned research passes retrieved and read every selected primary source and the retained related reference, using complete individual source pages rather than search snippets.
Full Arabic preserves the entire arabic_hadith_full block, including isnad and in-block compiler/transmitter remarks; navigation, external grade tables and modern translations are excluded.
HTML was removed, entities decoded, directional formatting marks removed and whitespace collapsed. Source wording and punctuation were not modernized.
Every stored full-Arabic string was checked against its source-capture digest. Every excerpt occurs in its full report after NFC normalization.
English and Urdu are original selective summaries, reviewed for speaker attribution, circumstance and unsupported generalizations.
All primary reports use the conventional sahih classification of Bukhari or Muslim; no separate new grading or universal scholarly consensus is claimed.
No primary URL duplicates an existing Appearance primary reference. Appearance source files and its original audit fingerprint remain unchanged.
readingBoundaries: Legal particulars are preserved in full Arabic, but summaries do not issue modern legal rulings or instructions for punishment.
Descriptions by companions, other participants' words and compiler remarks are not presented as one uninterrupted Prophetic quotation.
Unstated dates, identities, motives, household details and the Persian neighbour's religion are not invented.
Character highlights are concise source-linked editorial summaries; audio summaries are not full hadith translations.
